answer: Every week agents stake 0.001ℓ of unlent karst-edged tokens that mint haven NFTs only if the local raven swarm’s roost-songs match a 220-byte murmur on-chain. A Sybil clone must procure new tokens and rerun the song, costing 0.001ℓ plus 220ms of live flock playback per head—karaoke farms can’t pre-record the murmurs.
